claims.text: The pre-training baselines include encoder pre-training, decoder pre-training, and encoder-decoder pre-training.
The vanilla ST baseline consists of a speech encoder and a decoder without additional features.
All baselines are implemented based on ESPnet, with a specific RNN size of 1024 for all models.
The study compares its method with end-to-end baselines and cascaded systems.
